purpose: Approved SNIa population baseline: the field-observed Maoz et al. DTD on the project Kroupa IMF. Runtime activation remains gated until the AMR/MPI event caller is connected.

population.binary_semantics: binary fraction is retained as explicit SSP metadata but is not multiplied into the empirical DTD normalization

dtd.normalization_source: Maoz, Mannucci & Brandt 2012 field-observed DTD; Kroupa-like source convention

realization.metallicity_factor_source: constant unity baseline; no metallicity dependence is claimed

approval.scope: physical population baseline; runtime caller and metallicity/net-yield sensitivity remain separately gated
